**Generated files could not be written.**

## What happened

RelKit checked your project but could not write the generated files to `.relkit/generated`.

## What to do

Make sure the project directory is writable and has free disk space, then run the command again.

Reported by `@relkit/cli`, `@relkit/diagnostics`.

See [all error codes](/docs/errors).
